sources.note: Derived from saved Timeline words and cached music/vocal analyses. Existing source documents are unchanged; word timing confidence is preserved per cue.

formulas.wordGravity: log2(max(0.035, wordDurationSeconds) / 0.45), clamped [-2.4, 2.4], anchors at word midpoints, smoothstep interpolation.
formulas.phraseContrast: P_i = log2((T_word / max(0.14, syllables*0.195)) / (T_phrase / sum(T_normal_word))); syllable count is a spelling estimate.
formulas.phraseEmotional: Experiment 18 sample filters (.072/.026), contrast derivative clamp, gesture (.82/.36/.28), spring/damper, base Emotional Motion blend (.75/1.45), detrend.
formulas.vocalProsody: Experiment 18 RMS smoothing .22, confidence-weighted valid F0 deviation, response 1.9, spring/damper, detrend. No interpolation across invalid F0 points.
